findings.note: EN 'Audio rate limited' is a state; zh-CN '音频速率限制' is the noun for the limit itself, so this one class label names a mechanism where its five siblings (参数无效, 已拒绝, 未知工具, 重复ID, 策略拦截) name an outcome. Proposed: 音频限流 — the locale's established state form (ui.code_review.host.cooling: '{host}已触发限流，将持续到{time}。'). Non-gating: meaning is recoverable, no user is misled.

Value is correct in isolation; the defect is its composition with cancel.running. The callsite (image-gen-card.tsx:339-341) joins with a hard ASCII space, painting '…若产出音频则会计费。 正在确认结算。' — a space between two full-width sentences, which is not Chinese typography. Proposed: no catalogue change; make the join locale-aware (no separator when the following value starts full-width/CJK). zh-CN is the only CJK locale in this set.
